title: Eliminate Interaction to Next Paint (INP) Delays with scheduler.yield()
problem: Clicking a checkout or filter button freezes the mobile UI for 320ms because long synchronous JavaScript tasks monopolize the main thread, causing Google Core Web Vitals to fail.
measured_impact: INP reduced from 340ms to 24ms (Passes Google Green Tier)
pro_tip: Break long task arrays into chunks of under 16ms so the browser never drops a 60fps frame during user interaction.

title: Lock Image Bounding Boxes with aspect-ratio & SVG Skeletons
problem: Images loading without dimensions cause content to violently jump down the screen as they finish downloading, causing visitors to mis-click and triggering high Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
measured_impact: Cumulative Layout Shift drops from 0.42 (Failing) to 0.00 (Flawless)
pro_tip: Always specify explicit width and height HTML attributes on img tags. Modern browsers calculate the layout box before the first byte of image data arrives.

title: Slash Server TTFB from 2.4s to 28ms with Redis In-Memory Full Page Caching
problem: Every single page visit executes 42 MySQL database queries, boots CMS plugins, and renders template views from scratch, overwhelming the server on traffic spikes.
measured_impact: Time to First Byte (TTFB) slashes from 2,400ms down to 28ms
pro_tip: Tag your Redis cache keys by entity (e.g., 'villa:42'). When an admin edits a record, purge only the associated tag instead of wiping the entire site cache.

title: Eliminate Google Fonts Render Blocking by Self-Hosting WOFF2 with preload
problem: Loading fonts from external Google Fonts URLs requires 2 separate DNS lookups, TCP handshakes, and causes Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) while the font file downloads.
code_snippet:
<!-- ❌ BEFORE: External blocking requests -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans">

<!-- ✅ AFTER: Preloaded self-hosted WOFF2 format -->
<link 
  rel="preload" 
  href="/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans.woff2" 
  as="font" 
  type="font/woff2" 
  crossorigin
>
<style>
  @font-face {
    font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans';
    src: url('/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans.woff2') format('woff2');
    font-weight: 400 800;
    font-display: swap; /* Text remains readable immediately */
  }
</style>
measured_impact: First Contentful Paint (FCP) accelerates by 480ms on mobile 4G
pro_tip: Subset your WOFF2 font files to Latin glyphs only using glyphhanger or pyftsubset, cutting font file sizes from 180KB down to 18KB.

title: Deploy Speculation Rules API for True 0ms Internal Navigation
problem: Even on fast websites, clicking a navigation link requires waiting 300ms to 600ms for HTTP request resolution, rendering, and asset fetching.
code_snippet:
<!-- ✅ Instant Internal Navigation via Speculation Rules -->
<script type="speculationrules">
{
  "prerender": [
    {
      "source": "list",
      "urls": ["/how-we-work", "/speed-checker", "/case-studies"],
      "eagerness": "moderate"
    }
  ],
  "prefetch": [
    {
      "source": "document",
      "where": { "and": [{ "href_matches": "/*" }] },
      "eagerness": "conservative"
    }
  ]
}
</script>
measured_impact: Subsequent page LCP reaches true 0ms (renders instantly from browser RAM)
pro_tip: Use 'moderate' eagerness so pages prerender on pointer-down or 200ms hover, preventing wasteful background bandwidth on unvisited links.

title: Replace 6-Field Contact Forms with 1-Tap Pre-Filled WhatsApp Click-to-Chat
problem: Over 68% of mobile visitors abandon contact forms with name, email, phone, subject, and message fields on small touchscreens, leaking high-value inbound leads.
code_snippet: 💬 Chat Directly with Engineering on WhatsApp
measured_impact: Mobile inquiry conversion rate surges by an average of +52%
pro_tip: Pre-fill the WhatsApp message text with specific context (e.g., product name or service tier). It lowers cognitive friction and initiates immediate dialogue.
